schema: CREATE TABLE `shop_orders` (`id` int NOT NULL, `user_id` int NOT NULL, `time` int NOT NULL, `office_id` int NOT NULL, `status` int NOT NULL, `paid` tinyint NOT NULL, `paid_type` int NOT NULL, `how_get` int NOT NULL, `how_get_json` text NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`id`))

CREATE TABLE `shop_orders_items` (`id` int NOT NULL, `order_id` int NOT NULL, `status` int NOT NULL, `price` decimal(12,2) NOT NULL, `count_need` decimal(12,2) NOT NULL, `product_type` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 2, `product_id` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `t2_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `t2_article` varchar(128) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `t2_manufacturer` varchar(128) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `t2_time_to_exe` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `t2_time_to_exe_guaranteed` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (`id`))

CREATE TABLE `shop_orders_statuses_ref` (`id` int NOT NULL, `name` varchar(64) NOT NULL, `color` varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `order` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `for_paid` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (`id`))

CREATE TABLE `shop_orders_items_statuses_ref` (`id` int NOT NULL, `name` varchar(64) NOT NULL, `color` varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `order` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `count_flag` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY (`id`))
CREATE TABLE `shop_offices` (`id` int NOT NULL, `caption` varchar(128) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`id`))
CREATE TABLE `shop_orders_paid_type` (`id` int NOT NULL, `name` varchar(64) NOT NULL, `active` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, `order` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (`id`))

CREATE TABLE `shop_users_accounting` (`id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `user_id` int NOT NULL, `office_id` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `income` tinyint NOT NULL, `amount` decimal(12,2) NOT NULL, `active` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, `order_id` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (`id`))

CREATE TABLE `shop_docpart_garage` (`id` int NOT NULL, `user_id` int NOT NULL, `caption` varchar(255) NOT NULL, `vin` varchar(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `active` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY (`id`))
CREATE TABLE `shop_docpart_garage_orders` (`id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `order_id` int NOT NULL, `garage_id` int NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`id`))
CREATE TABLE `shop_orders_messages` (`id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `order_id` int NOT NULL, `read` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `is_customer` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (`id`))

CREATE TABLE `shop_print_docs` (`id` int NOT NULL, `name` varchar(64) NOT NULL, `caption` varchar(64) NOT NULL, `parameters_values` text NOT NULL, `control_available` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY (`id`))
CREATE TABLE `shop_print_docs_wholesaler` (`id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `doc_name` varchar(64) NOT NULL, `office_id` int NOT NULL, `parameters_values` text NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`id`))
CREATE TABLE `shop_obtaining_modes` (`id` int NOT NULL, `caption` varchar(64) NOT NULL, `handler` varchar(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY (`id`))

CREATE TABLE `shop_currencies` (`id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `iso_code` varchar(8) NOT NULL, `iso_name` varchar(16) NOT NULL, `caption_short` varchar(16) NOT NULL, `sign` varchar(16) NOT NULL, `rate` decimal(16,6) NOT NULL, `available` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, `order` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), UNIQUE KEY (`iso_code`))
CREATE TABLE `users_profiles` (`id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `user_id` int NOT NULL, `data_key` varchar(64) NOT NULL, `data_value` text NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`id`))
CREATE TABLE `epc_price_settings` (`setting_key` varchar(64) NOT NULL, `setting_value` varchar(255) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`setting_key`))
